access_links.label: Electricity demand on the openmod wiki

description: Open Data Reseaux-Energies is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Electricity demand > RTE time series for France", published or maintained by opendata.reseaux-energies.fr (publisher inferred from the link). The Open Data Reseaux-Energies has time series for continental France for demand from 2008-2018 (2019 is available but not validated), including subdivision in different zones. Additional information (with some gaps) on production from a variety of sources per region is available. Webpage is in French, but very reasonable to browse through. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Electricity demand" lists it under "RTE time series for France". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
licence: not stated on the wiki page (source page not read)
